notes: Live site www.kkreckons.com was not reachable from the sandbox (proxy 403); every number below is from a local production build.
Timings are local-only and say nothing about real-user performance.
Bytes are 'wire' bytes: encodedBodySize from the Resource Timing API where available (gzip from next start), otherwise content-length / body length.

build.framework: Next.js 16.4.3 (next build + next start -p 3100), React 19.3.1, images.unoptimized=true

css.units: All font sizes are px (grep for rem: 0 matches as a unit; the only 'rem' substring is in 'counter-increment'). Headline sizes use clamp(…px, …vw, …px).
fontFace: @font-face 'Playfair Display' 700, font-display: swap, src url(/fonts/playfair-700.woff2) (19,032 B on disk)
@font-face 'Playfair Display' 800, font-display: swap, src url(/fonts/playfair-800.woff2) (18,980 B on disk)
css.unusedFontDeps: package.json lists @fontsource/cormorant-garamond and @fontsource/playfair-display as dependencies; neither is imported anywhere in app/, components/ or lib/ (grep 'fontsource' finds only package.json).
reducedMotion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto } *, *::before, *::after { transition: none !important; animation: none !important } } (globals.css ~line 663)
colorScheme: 8 @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) blocks, each scoped to :root:not([data-theme="light"]), with a duplicate :root[data-theme="dark"] rule for the header toggle:
line 64: the full dark token set (--ink #ece8f2, --cream #14111b, --paper/--card #1e1a28, --accent #f29a6c …) plus color-scheme: dark
Theme choice persists in localStorage('theme') and is applied by an inline script in <head> before paint; <meta name=theme-color> is set for both schemes (#fbf8f1 / #14111b).
css.focusVisible: a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange) /* #ef7447 */; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px } — .es input[type=email]:focus sets outline: none and a 4px box-shadow instead.
css.shareRow: @media (max-width: 700px): .ev-share hides every button except .ev-share-one (a single 'Share' button that opens the OS share sheet or unfolds the row).
css.phoneHeader: @media (max-width: 700px): .site-header wraps to two rows (wordmark + toggle + Subscribe, then a horizontally scrollable nav with scrollbar hidden); nav links get padding 10px 0. @media (max-width: 360px): nav gap 12px, font-size 13px.

forms.emailSignup: components/EmailSignup.tsx renders <input type="email" inputMode="email" autoComplete="email" required> styled by .es input[type=email] { height: 46px; font: 16px var(--sans) } — but only when lib/site.ts INLINE_SIGNUP = Boolean(process.env.BEEHIIV_API_KEY). BEEHIIV_API_KEY is unset locally, so no email input renders on any page; the fallback is an external link to https://kkreckons.beehiiv.com/subscribe (target=_blank): 'Subscribe free ↗' / 'Get it by email ↗' and the header 'Subscribe' pill.
forms.archiveSearch: components/ArchiveBrowser.tsx renders <input id="archive-search" type="search" aria-label="Search stories" aria-keyshortcuts="/">. A global '/' key handler (components/SearchKey.tsx) focuses it or navigates to /daily/#search.
forms.notFoundSearch: app/not-found.tsx has a <form action="/daily/" method=get> with <input type=search name=q>.

routing.trailingSlash: GET /daily/ returns 308 Permanent Redirect to /daily. Source contains 13 internal links to "/daily/" (app/layout.tsx footer 'Past editions', components/SubscribeBox.tsx 'Catch up on past editions', app/week, app/month, app/daily/[slug]/[n] breadcrumb, app/not-found.tsx, …), so each of those clicks goes through the redirect. The header nav link uses /daily (no slash). Sitemap URLs have no trailing slashes.
routing.stressDataRewrite: next.config.mjs rewrites /ai-stress-index/data.json to https://kkreddy79.github.io/ai-implosion/data.json; locally this returns 500 because the sandbox cannot reach GitHub Pages.

headers.note: Measured against `next start` on localhost. Strict-Transport-Security is added by Vercel in production and is therefore absent here; CDN cache headers (age, x-vercel-cache) cannot be observed locally.
